value.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING with no preset-value presumption; ordinary full value standard applied. The headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of specific natural mathematical objects: the named cyclic STS(19) is sail-Ramsey (first exact sail-forcing certificate at a concrete order) with matching certified sail-free witnesses at orders 7/9/13/15 fixing a named-family threshold, plus dual-enumerator census numbers and two reusable lemmas (closing-pair automaticity; symmetric density obstruction explaining why majority counting cannot transfer). Object (sail S=123,345,561,147 in block-colorings of STS) and invariant (sail-free vs forcing) were motivated before computation by open Problem 1.3 / the unique <=4-block gap; values were not known or mechanically implied; a future researcher on sail-containing 5-block, STS chromatic-index, or high-girth Ramsey questions could reasonably need the precise witnesses, census numbers, and forcing certificate without recomputation. Honestly bounded (single named STS(19), not all STS(19); no claim on orders 16-18/20+ or asymptotics). This is the narrow-exact-datum case the value policy expressly permits, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration.

DPLL UNSAT trust rests on trace replay; mitigated by clause-set equality check, per-step forced-unit/genuine-conflict verification, closed-tree identity, and auditor's independent re-solve with a different heuristic also returning UNSAT.

Originality screening used Exa general + OpenAlex + Crossref + program sources; an obscure thesis/table with the same fixed-order coloring cannot be logically excluded, but high-recall synonymous/dominance/database queries found none.

Proposition 2's Latin sail-free family is certified computationally for m=3,4,5 in artifacts and auditor-extended to m=8; the general-m zero-sail fact is standard and separately re-derivable, not load-bearing for Theorems 1-3.
